title: Liu et al. (2020): ZnO electron-transport nanoparticle dispersion
scopeLabel: Source-scoped direct PbSe inks, selenium-precursor preparation, conventional comparison route, PbS and ZnO adjuncts, device fabrication, and distinct characterization and cost-estimation contexts. general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
